overall: Atlanta is tracking noticeably behind model expectations heading into the afternoon heating window. The HRRR's 84.8°F looks increasingly difficult to reach; ECMWF (82.8°F) and NBM (82.3°F) are more defensible but still require meaningful acceleration from a stalled warming trend.
max_temp_prediction: With the running max plateaued at 78.8°F and zero velocity at nearly noon, the burden falls entirely on the 1–4 PM heating window to close the gap to model guidance. Given the persistent wind (15 mph) and apparent cloud influence, a full recovery to the model consensus looks unlikely. A best estimate of around 81.5°F reflects modest afternoon warming resuming but falling short of the 82–85°F model range; confidence is low-to-moderate and the risk is skewed toward the downside given the stall.
